title: Developer @1a1a11a Launches 206B Token Agentic LLM Dataset
summary:
The new inference traces for AI agents comprise 1,186,582 requests and 1,213,347 tool calls across 12,002 separate sessions. Hosted on Hugging Face, the collection includes specific tool names, arguments and execution durations to provide visibility into how large language models (LLMs) interact with external tools during complex tasks.

Developer @1a1a11a announced the release on Oct 7 as the largest of its kind for agentic LLM inference, totaling 206B tokens. The project author will release a research paper detailing the dataset's creation and application at a later date.
